'''''Red Harvest''''' is a novel written by [[Joe Schreiber]], and a prequel to his earlier work, ''[[Death Troopers]]''. Originally titled '''''Black Orchid''''', the book was released on [[December 28]], [[2010]]. A hardcover horror novel,<ref name="SWMB">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=09495#17704281|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2009-08-14|time=9:38 AM}}</ref> it reveals the origin of the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|virus]] from the original book.<ref name="Interview">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/news20091016/index.html|text=''Death Troopers'': The Zombies You're Looking For}}</ref> On April 23, Sue Rostoni posted on the official site forums that the novel was re-titled due to internal concerns that the title ''Black Orchid'' sounded too much like a romance novel.<ref name="Board">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=270737&start=01560#17882958|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs 3.0|author=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2010-04-23|time=4:43 PM}}</ref> The book was released in paperback on [[February 28]], [[2012]]. Narration for the [[Red Harvest (audiobook)|audiobook]] was performed by [[John Glover]].
